Dog
Sparky is a dog who can be found at Bloomridge Park in the Lower City during Act Three.
“
Runrunrunrunrunrunrun - oh! Friend? Hello!
„
— Sparky

Involvement

Act Three

Sparky excitedly runs around park, just beyond the gate. If the interacting party member passes one of various checks, Sparky returns with his human  Albert to the Upper City. Otherwise, he continues to run around the park.

Without Speak with Animals

  • [ANIMAL HANDLING] Try to calm the overexcitable hound. (DC 25)
  • [BARD] [PERFORMANCE] Hum a calming lullaby to soothe the manic dog. (DC 25)

With Speak with Animals

  • [DECEPTION] Be careful - I heard dogs can only run one hundred times in their lives. (DC 15)
  • [PERSUASION] Running will feel even better tomorrow if you take a little break for the day. (DC 15)
